pages.title: Sacrifices
pages.text: Start the ritual before making an offering. A player must kill the required creature within $(bold)8 blocks$() of the golden bowl; arrows attributed to a player also count. The bowl never kills creatures automatically.$(br2)Only actual $()

pages.title: Sacrifices
pages.text: deaths count, not deaths canceled by rescue effects. Human sacrifices accept villagers or players, not witches. See each ritual's Sacrifice requirement for the required creature.
